description: AI solution for resume parsing and job matching.
context: HR department needed to automate resume screening and candidate-job matching.
projectDescription: Developed an NLP pipeline for CV parsing and a web platform for recruiter use.
roleContributions: Led a team of 2 interns for model and frontend integration
challengesSolutions: Messy resume formats → OCR preprocessing pipeline
High false positives → tuned thresholds and retrained embeddings
resultsImpact: Cut recruiter workload by >80% and reduced screening time to 1h per batch.
learningsTakeaways: Gained experience in NLP pipelines and team leadership.

description: Medical ML project for newborn cardiac state and breast cancer detection.
context: Healthcare partner needed predictive support for newborn monitoring and cancer detection.
projectDescription: Developed classification models for cardiac state and breast cancer prediction.
roleContributions: Collaborated with 5 engineers on model validation
challengesSolutions: Highly imbalanced datasets → applied resampling + weighted losses
resultsImpact: Achieved ~97% accuracy on cardiac model, competitive F1-score on cancer detection.
learningsTakeaways: Understood challenges of imbalanced medical datasets.
